name: UHMW Wheels
intro: UHMW-PE wheels are manufactured from virgin UHMW-PE powder by high pressure compression moulding. They carry high loads with low rolling and starting friction, do not damage floors and resist oil, grease and chemicals. Available as wheel only, fixed caster, swivel caster and swivel caster with brake.
features: Manufactured from virgin UHMW-PE powder — white colour — high pressure compression moulding
Ball bearing (BB) effort is 50% less than plain bore — 70% of industries use BB
High load carrying capacity / High impact strength / Low rolling & starting friction
Does NOT damage floors — ideal for polished and epoxy floors
Hardness: 75 Shore D / Excellent wear resistance / High cut-to-tear ratio
Resistant to oil, grease and chemicals / Max Working Temperature: 70°C
Does NOT crack under heavy or impact loads — unlike polypropylene or nylon wheels
